# ui.grid on every target: given `columns`, its children that many to a row
# in equal columns, and given none, a row that wraps where the next child
# would not fit. A loop's copies and a branch's nodes are each a cell of
# their own, the count follows the state it is read from, and the grid takes
# the children added after it was built.
#
# The snapshots are three columns, then two once `more` adds a Pokémon and
# a branch's: on bubbletea the screen as text, on html the grid's CSS, and
# on the others a picture that changes with the count.

env SNGL_UPDATE_SNAPSHOTS=1

sngl test --platform=none app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'

sngl test --platform=html app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
grep 'data-sngl-id="cards" style="gap: 8px; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat\(3, minmax\(0px, 1fr\)\);"' app.sngl.snapshots/three.html
grep 'grid-template-columns: repeat\(2, minmax\(0px, 1fr\)\)' app.sngl.snapshots/two.html
grep 'style="gap:8px;display:flex;width:240px;flex-wrap:wrap" data-sngl-id="types"' app.sngl.snapshots/three.html

sngl test --platform=bubbletea --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
# Three columns of a 60-cell box, each a third of it less the gaps; the flow
# is 30 cells wide, which ` Water ` would pass.
grep '(?m)^   Bulbasaur {10}Ivysaur {12}Venusaur {11}$' app.sngl.snapshots/three.ansi
grep '(?m)^   Charmander {9}Squirtle {30}$' app.sngl.snapshots/three.ansi
grep '(?m)^   Grass   Poison   Fire {36}$' app.sngl.snapshots/three.ansi
grep '(?m)^   Water   Electric   Psychic {31}$' app.sngl.snapshots/three.ansi
grep '(?m)^   Squirtle {20}Pikachu {22}$' app.sngl.snapshots/two.ansi
grep '(?m)^   Mew {54}$' app.sngl.snapshots/two.ansi

sngl test --platform=fyne --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/three.png app.sngl.snapshots/two.png

sngl test --platform=gtk4 --language=go app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/three.png app.sngl.snapshots/two.png

sngl test --platform=android --language=kotlin app.sngl
stdout 'ok +1 tests, 0 failures'
! cmp app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/three.png app.sngl.snapshots/robolectric/two.png

-- app.sngl --
import test "sngl:test"
import ui "sngl:ui"

component tile(label string) ui.node {
    ui.text(value=label, style={paddingY=4px, paddingX=8px})
}

component main ui.node {
    var cols option[int] = 3
    var names = ["Bulbasaur", "Ivysaur", "Venusaur", "Charmander", "Squirtle"]
    ui.vbox(style={gap=16px, padding=16px, width=480px}) {
        ui.grid #cards(columns=cols, style={gap=8px}) {
            for var n = names {
                tile(label=n)
            }
            if cols == 2 {
                tile(label="Mew")
            }
        }
        ui.grid #types(style={gap=8px, width=240px}) {
            for var t = ["Grass", "Poison", "Fire", "Water", "Electric", "Psychic", "Ice"] {
                tile(label=t)
            }
        }
        ui.button #more(text="More", @click {
            names.push("Pikachu")
            cols = 2
        })
    }
}

func testGrid(t test.Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.cards.columns == 3)
    t.assert(c.types.columns == null)
    t.snapshot("three")
    c.more.click()
    t.assert(c.cards.columns == 2)
    t.snapshot("two")
}
